name: Deploy to GitHub Pages on: push: branches: - acoustic jobs: build-and-deploy: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - name: Checkout Code uses: actions/checkout@v4 - name: Inject Secrets into JS files run: | # inject app.js sed -i "s/__MQTT_BROKER__/${{ secrets.MQTT_BROKER }}/g" app.js sed -i "s/__MQTT_PORT__/${{ secrets.MQTT_PORT }}/g" app.js sed -i "s/__MQTT_USER__/${{ secrets.MQTT_USER }}/g" app.js sed -i "s/__MQTT_PASS__/${{ secrets.MQTT_PASS }}/g" app.js # Inject overview.js sed -i "s/__MQTT_BROKER__/${{ secrets.MQTT_BROKER }}/g" overview.js sed -i "s/__MQTT_PORT__/${{ secrets.MQTT_PORT }}/g" overview.js sed -i "s/__MQTT_USER__/${{ secrets.MQTT_USER }}/g" overview.js sed -i "s/__MQTT_PASS__/${{ secrets.MQTT_PASS }}/g" overview.js - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages uses: JamesIves/github-pages-deploy-action@v4 with: folder: . branch: gh-pages # Branch tujuan untuk hosting
